summary: Constitutional validity of Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) (Amendment) Acts 1951 and 1965; Article 30(1) applicability to pre-Constitution universities; minority establishment vs administration rights; 'establish and administer' conjunctive interpretation; Muslim minority's historical control over AMU rejected.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; Constitutional validity of 1951 and 1965 AMU Amendments upheld. AMU not established by Muslim minority under Article 30(1).
